_help: VPN providers for alchemos-vpn and the HUD (Control Center tile, bar, Settings → NETWORK).
Fields: id (used by `alchemos-vpn toggle <id>` and `qs ipc call vpn toggle <id>`), name (short, shown on the tile),
label (longer, shown in Settings), type (protonvpn | nm), enabled.
Only one provider is connected at a time; connecting one disconnects the others.

providers.name: PROTON
providers.label: Proton VPN (free)
providers._country: empty = fastest free server anywhere; or a code like CA / NL / US

providers.name: SCHOOL
providers.label: UWaterloo (Cisco)
providers.auth_hint: WatIAM username, then password. The SECOND 'Password:' is Duo: push, phone, sms, or a passcode.
_setup: vpn.uwaterloo.ca = Cisco AnyConnect, group UW-General, plain form (username / password / Duo as secondary password).
Runs through openconnect + NetworkManager (openconnect, networkmanager-openconnect), no Cisco client.

nmcli con add type vpn vpn-type openconnect con-name 'UWaterloo VPN' autoconnect no vpn.data 'gateway=vpn.uwaterloo.ca,protocol=anyconnect,cookie-flags=2,gateway-flags=2,gwcert-flags=2,enable_csd_trojan=no'
auth "terminal": every connect opens a small login window (or prompts in the terminal you ran alchemos-vpn from);
nmcli --ask runs `openconnect --authenticate` and NM gets only the one-time session cookie. Nothing is saved.
